# LinkedIn Activity Scraper

> Send a profile URL you already have. You get recent likes, comments, and post links you can use to personalize outreach.

Mawsool publishes this as an Apify Actor. Starting from $0.45 per 1,000 profiles.

## Run

- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-activity
- Call: `oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-activity`
- API key: https://mawsool.tech/ and https://docs.mawsool.tech/
- Contact: osama@mawsool.tech, info@mawsool.tech

## Use it when

You want something the person just did, before you write.

## Use something else when

You want the job history or the full profile. Use the Experience Scraper or the LinkedIn Profile Scraper.

## Page

- LinkedIn likes, comments, and posts from a profile URL: docs/linkedin-profile-activity.md

Mawsool is not affiliated with LinkedIn.
